keys.leaf: \bleaf\b.{0,30}\b(head|forehead|hat)|\b(head|forehead)\b.{0,30}\bleaf\b|you'?re (a|just a) tanuki|i see (through|the leaf)|(you'?re|you are) not (a|really a) (monk|priest|lady|kettle|teakettle)

lines.opener: *a round little monk with a leaf on his head bows to you* Alms, alms for a holy man! Ehehe... or perhaps you'd like to buy a teakettle? Very cheap! Pon-poko-pon!
lines.openerHostile: *a fat raccoon dog drums his belly like a war drum* Oi, oi! This road is tanuki road! Toll or tumble!
lines.like: *drums his belly* Pon-poko-pon! Ehehe, you're a fun one!
lines.dislike: *his ears droop; the leaf slides over one eye* Oi... that's no way to treat a fellow.
lines.hate: *the tanuki goes white under his fur* S-soup?! *POOF: there is only a leaf, spinning on the floor*
lines.flirt: *puffs out his belly and waggles his eyebrows* Oho! A charmer! Let's go drinking, handsome, my treat! ...You pay.
lines.join: *hops up on your shoulder* Ehehe! You're all right. I'll come along. Somebody's got to carry the sake!
lines.demand: Say, friend... you wouldn't have a little sake on you? Just a sip?
lines.gift: *presses a shiny gold coin into your hand* For you! Real gold! Probably! Spend it before morning!
lines.thanks: *glug glug* Ahhh! Now THAT's the stuff! Pon-poko-pon!
lines.letPass: *waves a paw* Go on, go on! Mind the foxes!
lines.ai: A-I? Is that a kind of fox? I don't trust foxes.
lines.refuseJoin: Ehehe, not so fast! Buy me a drink first!
lines.leaveNow: *clutches his chest and keels over* Urk! I'm dead. Totally dead. *opens one eye* ...You should go fetch a priest. Will you?
